name: Create Drone Assailant
body:
School transmutation; Level sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a steel ball worth 15 gp)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as create drone, except it grows to a Small-sized construct that appears in a space within range. Its damage is increased to 1d10 + 1 point per three caster levels (maximum +5 at 15th level), it can attack as a normal creature and can provide flanking based upon its positioning. Its AC is reduced to 18, but its HP is increased to 8 times your caster level + 10 and its hardness is 10.
